description: This Java class defines a ClusterCommandEvent used in a Zigbee simulation or testing framework. It models a Zigbee cluster command received event with properties like EUI64, profile ID, cluster ID, command ID, RSSI, LQI, and methods for encoding payloads.

classes.name: ClusterCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a Zigbee cluster command received event with properties such as EUI64, profile ID, cluster ID, command ID, RSSI, LQI, and methods for payload encoding.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of the device.

methods.name: getProfileId
methods.description: Returns the profile ID associated with the event.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the event (1 for server, 0 for client).

methods.name: getMfgSpecific
methods.description: Indicates if the command is manufacturer-specific.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Returns the command payload bytes; meant to be overridden.
